feed.title: Autonomous Learning Group
feed.subtitle: The Autonomous Learning Group (Distributed Intelligence) at the University of Tübingen studies how embodied agents can learn autonomously: reinforcement learning, representation learning, intrinsic motivation, and haptic sensing.

entry.title: Our new website
entry.content: Welcome to the new website of the Autonomous Learning Group! Here you will find our research projects, all our publications, and news from the group. Teaching and open positions remain on the university website.
